existing_reuse_note: Caller methods from the merged somatic batch; Strelka2 configures somatic-20261009-method-strelka. DRAGEN reuses the existing cnv-20261009-method-dragen record (described as the DRAGEN platform). Octopus is the only new method.
tables_taken: Additional file 2 Tables S2 (WGS replicates by centre), S3 (purity, coverage, contaminated normal) and S4 (library preparation), every cell. 2,464 results; SomaticSniper and MuSE print '-' for indels and have no indel evaluations.

training_data.NeuSomatic and NeuSomatic-S DREAM3: DREAM Challenge Stage 3 in silico data; no SEQC2 data. Kept; origin author_reported.
training_data.NeuSomatic and NeuSomatic-S SEQC-WGS-Spi: In silico tumours from HCC1395BL WGS replicates (eight pairs from four sites, 40x-95x, plus two merged Illumina NovaSeq pairs), whole genome, no HCC1395 truth labels.
training_data.NeuSomatic and NeuSomatic-S SEQC-WGS-GT-: Eight real HCC1395/HCC1395BL WGS pairs (seven from six centres, one ~390x merged NovaSeq) with SEQC2 truth labels in 50% of the high-confidence genome, plus in silico purity mixtures.
training_data.NeuSomatic and NeuSomatic-S SEQC-WGS-GT5: All GT-50 candidates plus 10% of Spike candidates.
training_data.Octopus-RF: Results: random forest trained on the SEQC-WGS-GT50-SpikeWGS10 training data. Methods: 'the pretrained random forest model'. Treated as SEQC2-trained.

leakage.evaluation_region: All tables score the 50% of the high-confidence genome held out from GT-50 training, so no truth label used in training is scored. The cell line and truth set are shared, and in Table S2 the training replicates are among the 21 scored pairs (not identified).

summary_proposal.value: Sahraeian et al. 2022 (the NeuSomatic developers) scored nine conventional callers and NeuSomatic models on SEQC2 HCC1395 whole-genome data, in the half of the genome held out from model training. Models trained on SEQC2 HCC1395 data, including Octopus with the authors' random forest, are set aside because they were built from the test cell line. Across 21 replicate pairs from several centres, average SNV F1 was 92.3% for DRAGEN 3.7.5, 89.0% for Strelka2, 88.1% for MuSE, 87.1% for Lancet, 86.1% for Octopus with hard filters and 85.8% for MuTect2 4.beta.6; NeuSomatic with its DREAM3 model, trained only on simulated data, reached 91.8%. Indel F1 averaged 81.7% for DRAGEN, 79.3% for NeuSomatic DREAM3, 77.7% for Lancet, 73.7% for MuTect2 and 72.8% for Strelka2. Accuracy fell sharply with tumour purity: at 80x, SNV F1 at 10% purity was 44.2-56.5% for Strelka2, MuTect2, Lancet, DRAGEN, Octopus with hard filters and NeuSomatic DREAM3, against 88.6-95.4% at full purity, and 20.8% for MuSE. With a normal contaminated by 5% tumour, MuTect2 and Lancet lost about half their SNV F1 at full purity (88.6% to 43.8% for MuTect2) and MuSE about a third (91.6% to 59.5%), while Strelka2 (92.4% to 90.9%) and NeuSomatic DREAM3 (95.2% to 91.5%) changed little. With 1 ng TruSeq-Nano libraries every caller performed poorly; DRAGEN had the best average indel F1 over the six library-preparation pairs (72.5%). All results come from one cell line, an F1 metric only and caller versions from 2017 to 2021.
summary_proposal.note: Covers the new judgements only; to be merged with the existing summary for this use case.

concerns_for_reviewer.locator: Results 'Analysis of different model-building strategies' paragraph 9 versus Methods 'Somatic mutation detection algorithms' paragraph 1
concerns_for_reviewer.message: Results say Octopus-RF used 'random forest filtering trained on SEQC-WGS-GT50-SpikeWGS10 data'; Methods say 'the pretrained random forest model'. Octopus-RF is treated as SEQC2-trained and author-built (origin author_reported) and proposed for exclusion. If the reviewer reads it as Octopus's own pretrained forest, its six evaluations could be kept as independent_paper.

concerns_for_reviewer.locator: Results 'WGS dataset' paragraph 1; Additional file 2 Table S2 row labels
concerns_for_reviewer.message: Prose says 21 WGS replicates from six sequencing centres; the row labels carry seven site codes (EA, FD, IL, LL, NC, NS, NV). Recorded as printed; not resolved.

The training replicate pairs are described by site and coverage but not named, so Table S2 rows that are training replicates cannot be identified. All SEQC2-trained evaluations on S2 are proposed for exclusion for that reason as well as the cell-line rule; S3 and S4 rows are proposed under the cell-line rule only.

concerns_for_reviewer.locator: Methods 'SEQC2 tumor-normal sequencing data and ground truth'; author list
concerns_for_reviewer.message: The SEQC2 truth set was derived with SomaticSeq over calls from several callers; co-author Li Tai Fang leads SomaticSeq. SomaticSeq is not evaluated here, but the truth set may favour callers that contributed to it. Recorded as a protocol limitation.
